Course Description: 
This course provides the basic concepts and skill sets to undertake urban land use and 
transportation planning and to analyze the impact of various policies either related to 
infrastructure development, environmental regulation and urban expansion. 
Course Learning Objectives: 
1. Understand and apply basic concepts and methods of urban transportation planning.  
2. Apprise about the methods of designing, conducting and administering surveys to provide the 
data required for transportation planning.  
3. Understand the process of developing an organized mathematical modelling approach to solve 
select urban transportation planning problem.  
4. Excel in use of various types of models used for travel forecasting, prediction of future travel 
patterns.
